profile.headline: Software Engineer at Komatsu
profile.summary: Computer Engineering graduate with over 8 years of labor-intensive work experience and extensive knowledge of computer-related fields. Possess strong academic record with multiple placements in academic competitions and highly adaptable in most situations. Possess strong desire to complete assigned tasks, particularly difficult ones, and will ask questions where necessary. Prefer to follow the lead of others but more than ready to take the lead when necessary. Very comfortable in remote work settings with a desire to work autonomously, but closely with team.

positions.title: Group Project Manager
positions.description:
 Fabricated 50 novel Graphene FETs using an experimental fabrication process involving a Top-Gate design
and a PDMS oxide layer
 Assigning fabrication tasks in cleanroom to 4 team members to improve efficiency of process
 Managing fabrication resources such as allocated wafers and lithography masks to avoid damage and ensuring
enough resources were available for complete fabrication of 50 devices in event of a problem
 Performed group Characterization and Circuit Analysis of 50 micro-scale GFET devices, with a 22% final
yield of working devices

company.name: University of Pittsburgh Swanson School of Engineering

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
 Assigning tasks and regulating work for 7 team members in a separated, remote environment through Agile Methods using Atlassian Jira
 Created a 7-segment, modular, hardware/software implementation of an autonomous multi-train control
system as a team of 7 members
 Ensured bi-weekly deadlines were met and questions were brought up to correct administrators
 Oversaw communication between 7 team members and hosted group discussions on communication
platforms such as Zoom and Discord
